label: Reprimand
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A formal dressing-down on the record. It costs pride and a little composure.

label: Privileges revoked
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: No company beyond the work and no messages, for a day.

label: Confinement
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The commander is held in quarters and loses part of the day.

label: Public humiliation
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A reprimand in front of the squad. It costs standing with every soldier.

label: Pain burst
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A burst through the implant. It hurts, and a weak body may not take it well.

label: Compel
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A neural compliance burst: the commander's next choice is not the commander's own.

label: Suppress
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: A full lockdown of the commander for the rest of the day.
